content.text: {"incident_detected":true,"root_cause_hypothesis":"A genuine KYC approval-rate break began around 2025-11-13. The strongest fingerprint is Android national-ID submissions: November doc_unreadable rejections surged, consistent with a document capture/readability regression. The data supports that as the likely cause, but does not identify a specific app release; the initial version-attribution query could not run because dim_users has no platform column.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"overall KYC approval rate before break","baseline_value":0.889,"anomaly_value":0.821,"unit":"fraction","sql":"calculate_uplift_or_stats, analysis=kyc_changepoint, all platforms and document types; break date 2025-11-13"},{"name":"weekly KYC approval rate","baseline_value":0.893204,"anomaly_value":0.819102,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT date_trunc('week', decision_date)::DATE AS wk, SUM(n_decisions) decisions, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date >= DATE '2025-09-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1; baseline week 2025-09-29, anomaly week 2025-11-17"},{"name":"Android national_id KYC approval rate","baseline_value":0.88786,"anomaly_value":0.766505,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT platform, doc_type, SUM(n_decisions) n, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31' GROUP BY 1,2; anomaly value from SELECT platform, doc_type, SUM(n_decisions), SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-15' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1,2"},{"name":"Android national_id doc_unreadable rejections","baseline_value":76,"anomaly_value":364,"unit":"count","sql":"SELECT month, platform, doc_type, reject_reason, SUM(n_rejections) n FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE month >= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4; comparing October and November 2025"}],"recommended_action":"ROLLBACK_RELEASE","reasoning_summary":"The changepoint scan detects a break on 2025-11-13, with approval falling from 0.889 to 0.821—well beyond ordinary weekly movement (roughly 0.88–0.90 before the break, then about 0.82). Android national-ID approval was 0.88786 in September–October and 0.766505 in the recent window; its doc_unreadable rejection count jumped from 76 in October to 364 in November. This points to a likely Android document-capture/readability regression; investigate and roll back the implicated release, while confirming release attribution before executing the rollback."}
